capabilities: Blur the workspace except a spotlight area around the cursor
Toggle the privacy screen via ribbon icon, command, or hotkey
Adjust spotlight size, shape, offset, blur intensity, and edge feathering
Track the text cursor or the mouse pointer
Remember the on/off state across Obsidian sessions
extras: The README warns that text-cursor tracking uses the undocumented editor.cm CodeMirror 6 internal, which could break on future Obsidian updates; mouse tracking is unaffected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to obscure on-screen content from shoulder-surfers while still seeing a small area around where you're working.
summary: Blur overlay that hides the Obsidian workspace except a configurable spotlight around the cursor, for privacy when working in public.
